skill.name: web-search
skill.description: Run current web research through the Gemini CLI for technical questions that need recent sources, citations, and synthesized findings.
skill.summary: Uses a Gemini CLI web-search workflow to gather current, cited technical research.
skill.author: Cain96

security_audit.summary: The SKILL.md backtick detections are Markdown formatting and examples, so I treated them as false positives for shell backtick execution. The bundled script still creates a real security concern because it invokes Gemini with --yolo while handling user-provided search prompts. No prompt injection text was found in the skill documentation.

remediation.suggestion: Remove --yolo and require explicit confirmation for any Gemini action beyond returning search results.
Constrain the script to search-only behavior and document the exact Gemini permissions required before installation.

semantic_findings.title: Gemini CLI Auto-Approval Mode
semantic_findings.description: The helper script embeds the user search query into a Gemini prompt and runs gemini with --yolo. Auto-approval mode can allow model actions without interactive confirmation while processing arbitrary prompts or web content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 23 stores the user query and lines 26-39 pass it to gemini with --yolo. Exact impact depends on local Gemini CLI permissions, but the unsafe auto-approval mode is explicit.

content.user_title: Search the Web with Gemini CLI
content.value_statement: Current technical research can be slow when answers depend on recent sources. This skill runs a Gemini CLI search workflow that returns cited Markdown research.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Bash wrapper that sends a user-provided search query to the Gemini CLI.
Requests current web research with source URLs and Markdown-formatted answers.
Supports queries for official documentation, error messages, release notes, and technology comparisons.
Encourages synthesis across multiple sources when the answer benefits from comparison.
Provides example query patterns for technical research, debugging, news, and migration planning.
limitations: Requires the Gemini CLI to be installed, configured, and authenticated before use.
Depends on external web results, so users must verify source quality and recency.
Does not replace local code inspection for questions already answerable from the repository.
The packaged script uses Gemini auto-approval mode unless the author removes --yolo.

use_cases.title: Research Framework Updates
use_cases.description: Find recent release notes, migration guidance, and official documentation for fast-moving developer tools.

use_cases.title: Resolve Error Messages
use_cases.description: Search public discussions and documentation for likely causes and fixes for specific build or runtime errors.

use_cases.title: Compare Technical Options
use_cases.description: Gather cited advantages, trade-offs, and adoption signals before choosing a library, framework, or workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Find Official Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for the latest official documentation about [topic]. Summarize the key points and include source URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for this exact error: [error message]. Explain common causes, reliable fixes, and sources from documentation or trusted discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [use case]. Include strengths, weaknesses, current maintenance status, and cited sources.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research for a decision record.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [decision topic] using recent primary sources. Separate facts, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations, with source URLs for each claim.

output_examples.input: Search for the latest Next.js release notes and migration guidance.
output_examples.output: A concise research summary with release highlights, migration risks, official documentation links, and dated source references.

output_examples.input: Find causes of a TypeScript assignment error and trusted fixes.
output_examples.output: An explanation of likely causes, several repair strategies, and links to relevant documentation or public issue discussions.

output_examples.input: Compare Vite and Webpack for a large React application.
output_examples.output: A structured comparison covering performance, ecosystem support, configuration complexity, migration cost, and source URLs.

best_practices: Prefer official documentation and primary sources when asking for current technical facts.
Include versions, dates, error text, and project constraints in the search query.
Verify important claims across more than one source before acting on the result.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for information already available in the local repository.
Do not treat generated search summaries as authoritative without checking cited sources.
Do not send secrets, private code, or sensitive business details in search queries.

faq.question: What does this skill use for search?
faq.answer: It uses a Bash helper that calls the Gemini CLI with a structured web-research prompt.

faq.question: Does it require external credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The Gemini CLI must be installed and configured with valid access before the skill can work.

faq.question: Can it cite sources?
faq.answer: Yes. The prompt asks Gemini to include source URLs and synthesize information from multiple sources.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private data?
faq.answer: No. Search queries may leave the local environment, so sensitive data should not be included.

faq.question: When should I use local file search instead?
faq.answer: Use local search when the answer depends on files already present in the current repository.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: The bundled script uses Gemini auto-approval mode, which should be removed before broad publication.
